text:
lin (release): Quick sync: proposing unpin of runtime v3.2 -> v3.3 across eu/us in Saturday 02:00 UTC window. Need canary, rollback plan, and release note blurb.

sam (eng): okay. staged by model-group? longseq models keep pinned until kv-cache validated >8k.

pri (pm): recommend 2% canary for 45m, then 10% for 30m, full roll after smoke. Add note about possible p95 uptick.

deploy-bot: created CR#202404-UNPIN-RUNTIME-1777771122: region=eu-west-1, canary=2%, expand=45m,10%:30m, full:60m. hooks=/hook/obs,/hook/eval-checks.

alex (ops): ops checklist: update pinlist, precreate rollback tag runtime-v3.2-pinback-1777771122, set escape hatch commands. I'll reserve the on-call slot.

marta (sre): rollback triggers: error rate +0.5% (5m) OR p95 >1200ms for 3m OR eval regressions >2% on longseq set. On trigger: pause expansion, execute rollback tag, run /ops/sync-pinlist.

sam (eng): compatibility note: v3.3 flips kernel selection to interleaved KV by default; expect +5-10% CPU on warmup for non-quant llama2q. Watch kv-cache miss rate and p50->p95 spread.

lin (release): draft release note: "Runtime v3.3: improved kernel selection & interleaved KV for memory efficiency. Rolling canary in eu-west-1 02:00 UTC. Long-sequence users may see short warmup latency increases; contact support for safeguards."

pri (pm): add: "High-llama2q models remain pinned until validation passes."

sam (eng): added.

alex (ops): deploy command for ops:
```
deploy-bot trigger --cr CR#202404-UNPIN-RUNTIME-1777771122 \\
  --region eu-west-1 --canary 2% --expand-steps 45m,30m,60m \\
  --rollback-tag runtime-v3.2-pinback-1777771122
```

deploy-bot: CR#202404-UNPIN-RUNTIME-1777771122 queued. Next action: trigger by alex at 02:00 UTC.

lin (release): final readiness check at 23:00 UTC tonight. Post release-note blurb then. :thumbsup:

marta (sre): monitoring dashboard: /dashboards/runtime/unpin-1777771122. I'll post heartbeats at 02:10 and 02:40.

sam (eng): standing by for logs and eval diffs. hold canary if any red flags.

alex (ops): noted. will run trigger and coordinate rollback if needed.

lin (release): thanks all — moving to go/no-go schedule.
